title: RISC-V processor in the FPGA
summary: A third processor next to the two ARM cores: Ardzy's own RV32I RISC-V core with 16 KB RAM, LEDs, GPIO, timers, a console and mailboxes. Write assembly in the app, the ARM assembles and loads it.
wiring: LEDs with 330 ohm, buzzers through a transistor
buttons to GND (the pull-ups are on)
parts: nothing needed: the 4 board LEDs show the programs
optional: LEDs and buttons on J8 / J5
tested: the self-test passed 6 of 6 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
